# BetterFriendlist

**The social window I always wanted World of Warcraft to have.**

  [![Download on CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-Download-f16436?logo=curseforge&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/betterfriendlist)
  [![Download on Wago](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wago-Download-c1272d)](https://addons.wago.io/addons/betterfriendlist)
  [![Download on WoWInterface](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoWInterface-Download-2e8bce)](https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info26984-BetterFriendlist.html)
  [![Join the Discord community](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Community-5865f2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/dpaV8vh3w3)

WoW's default Friends frame is fine when your list is short. Once it fills up with Battle.net contacts, alts, guildmates, raid regulars, and people you met once three expansions ago, finding the right person becomes a small project of its own.

BetterFriendlist started with a simple idea: the Friends frame should help you remember **who people are and what you play together**. From there it grew one everyday annoyance at a time: groups, tags, nicknames, better search and sorting, guild and raid tools, Quick Join, a proper Who list, and plenty of ways to make the window feel like your own.

It is meant to feel familiar on the first login. You can keep the Blizzard look and use the defaults, or tune almost every part of the experience if that is your thing.

## What BetterFriendlist does

### Organize the people you actually play with

- **Custom groups** — Create as many groups as you need, give them names and colors, assign friends to more than one group, and reorder everything with drag and drop.
- **Useful automatic groups** — Favorites, In-Game, Recently Added, and No Group keep important contacts visible without extra upkeep. Their visibility, order, names, and colors can be adjusted.
- **Friend tags** — Use Blizzard-compatible interests and roles or create your own tags. Tags can have custom labels, icons, colors, and visibility rules, appear as compact chips, participate in search, or form dynamic groups without changing friend notes.
- **Nicknames** — Give WoW and Battle.net friends a name that means something to you. Nicknames are used consistently in the list, tooltips, menus, and supported guild and Broker views.
- **Bulk actions** — Select several friends at once to update group or tag assignments together.
- **Import, export, and migration tools** — Move group data between installations, import an existing FriendGroups setup, and clean old FriendGroups markers from notes with backup and restore support.

### Find the right person quickly

- **Live search** checks real names, BattleTags, character names, nicknames, notes, realms, and enabled friend tags.
- **QuickFilters** cover everyday views such as Online, Offline, WoW, Battle.net, In-Game, Hide AFK, and supported queue states.
- **Primary and secondary sorting** can combine status, name, level, zone, game, faction, guild, class, or realm.
- **Custom QuickFilters and sorters** can be built from detailed rules when the optional beta editor is enabled.
- **Custom name and info formats** let you decide exactly what each friend row says. Presets handle the common layouts, while tokens such as `%nickname%`, `%character%`, `%realm%`, `%level%`, `%zone%`, `%class%`, and `%game%` cover the rest.

### Choose how the window should feel

On supported Retail clients, players can switch between two complete interfaces:

- **Modern** follows Blizzard's current Social UI with friend cards and a configurable side navigation. Tabs can be reordered, hidden, or shown only when they contain something useful.
- **Legacy** keeps the familiar BetterFriendlist layout and is also the standard interface on Classic clients.

Both styles share the same friends, groups, tags, and settings. Switching does not require starting over.

There is also a **Simple Mode** for a quieter frame, a **Compact Mode** for denser lists, and detailed controls for window size, scale, position, fonts, colors, row contents, group headers, icons, and click behavior.

Five visual themes are available:

- Blizzard
- Dark
- Custom, with its own color palette and opacity controls
- ElvUI, when ElvUI is installed
- EllesmereUI, when EllesmereUI skinning is available

### Keep the rest of WoW's social tools close

BetterFriendlist is more than a reskinned list. Depending on the game client and the APIs Blizzard provides, the same window can also bring together:

| Area | What it adds |
| --- | --- |
| **Friend Requests** | Review incoming requests in the same interface as the rest of your friends. |
| **Recent Allies** | Find players you recently grouped with, including pinned and converted legacy contacts on supported Retail clients. |
| **Quick Join** | Browse groups your friends are forming, see who is involved, and request an invite. Available on Retail. |
| **Recruit A Friend** | Keep Blizzard's recruit list, rewards, and recruitment actions connected to the main social window. Available on Retail. |
| **Guild** | An optional guild roster with search, online filters, sorting, nicknames, member details, and supported guild-management actions. Currently a beta feature. |
| **Who** | A rebuilt `/who` view with responsive columns, class and level coloring, search history, configurable double-click actions, and a search builder for names, levels, guilds, zones, races, and classes. |
| **Ignore & Broadcast** | Blizzard's related social windows remain reachable and are positioned and themed alongside BetterFriendlist where supported. |

Features tied to a specific Blizzard system are only shown on clients that provide that system. The rest of the addon continues to work normally.

## Raid tools

The built-in raid roster shows all eight raid groups at once, with class colors, class and role icons, leader and assistant ranks, Main Tank and Main Assist markers, Master Looter, ready-check results, and live role counts.

Raid leaders and assistants can:

- Drag individual players between groups or use multi-selection for bulk moves.
- Assign configurable modifier-click shortcuts for Main Tank, Main Assist, Raid Leader, and Assistant.
- Sort the roster by role, split it into balanced halves or odd/even groups, preserve selected groups, and optionally balance DPS.
- Resume an interrupted roster operation after combat.
- Promote tanks together or let **Auto Raid Assist** promote selected friends and characters when they join.
- Start a ready check and open saved raid information directly from the roster.

WoW's combat and permission restrictions still apply; BetterFriendlist will pause or disable actions when the game does not allow them.

## Broker displays

BetterFriendlist provides separate **Friends** and **Guild** LibDataBroker objects for display addons such as Titan Panel, Bazooka, Arcana, ChocolateBar, and similar tools.

The Broker tooltips can show grouped and sortable contact lists, online totals, friend tags, status and game details, guild ranks, zones, notes, last-online information, and configurable columns. Click actions and tooltip appearance can be tailored independently from the main frame.

## Privacy and syncing

- **Streamer Mode** replaces Real IDs with BattleTags, nicknames, or notes throughout BetterFriendlist so a stream or recording does not reveal personal names.
- **Private Notes** can store your own context for friends and ignored players without writing it into Blizzard's public friend-note field. This feature is opt-in.
- **Global Friend Sync** can keep WoW friends available across characters and realms on the same account. Deletion syncing is a separate opt-in setting.
- **FriendGroups note sync** is available for people who still share group assignments through the established FriendGroups note format.

Personal groups, custom tags, private notes, nicknames, and settings are stored in BetterFriendlist's local SavedVariables. Optional integrations such as CustomNames may share the relevant data through their own local libraries.

## Addon compatibility

BetterFriendlist includes dedicated support for several popular UI and social addons, including:

- ElvUI, EllesmereUI, AddOnSkins, and LibSharedMedia
- CustomNames and FriendListColors
- Global Ignore List and EnhanceQoL's Ignore List
- Total RP 3
- Northern Sky Raid Tools
- LibDataBroker display addons

The optional **BetterFriendlist Menu Bridge** can expose supported actions from compatible addons inside BetterFriendlist context menus. Because modern WoW protects some social data and actions, this integration is deliberately opt-in and only appears where it can operate safely.

## Retail and Classic support

BetterFriendlist is maintained from one shared codebase for Retail and the supported Classic families. That currently includes Retail 11.x and 12.x clients, Classic Era/Anniversary, and supported Classic progression clients.

The addon checks for capabilities instead of assuming every client has the same APIs. Retail-only features such as Quick Join, Recent Allies, Recruit A Friend, and the Modern Social UI stay out of the way on Classic, while groups, search, sorting, Who, guild tools, raid tools, themes, and the Legacy interface adapt to the client where supported.

For the exact game versions attached to the latest release, see the file list on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/betterfriendlist/files), [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/betterfriendlist), or [WoWInterface](https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info26984-BetterFriendlist.html).

## Localization

BetterFriendlist is fully localized in 11 languages:

- English
- German
- French
- Spanish (Europe and Latin America)
- Italian
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Russian
- Korean
- Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)

## Installation and first steps

The easiest option is to install BetterFriendlist through [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/betterfriendlist), [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/betterfriendlist), or [WoWInterface](https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info26984-BetterFriendlist.html).

For a manual installation:

1. Download the latest release and extract it.
2. Place the `BetterFriendlist` folder in `World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns` or the matching folder for your Classic client.
3. Enable BetterFriendlist on the character-selection screen and log in.

Open the social window normally or type `/bfl`. Use `/bfl settings` to jump straight to the options. On supported Retail clients, the first-run setup helps you choose an interface style and theme; every choice can be changed later.

## Feedback and support

BetterFriendlist has grown through real use, bug reports, and the little annoyances people notice only after opening the Friends frame for the thousandth time. If something feels awkward, does not work on your WoW client, or would save you a few clicks every day, I would genuinely like to hear about it.

- [Join the Discord community](https://discord.gg/dpaV8vh3w3) for help, feedback, and discussion.
- [Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/Hayato2846/BetterFriendlist/issues) for reproducible bugs and feature requests.
- [Support development on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/hayato2846) if BetterFriendlist has made your time in WoW a little easier.
- Read the [changelog](https://github.com/Hayato2846/BetterFriendlist/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for recent additions and fixes.

BetterFriendlist is maintained by [Hayato2846](https://github.com/Hayato2846) and distributed under the terms in the [license](https://github.com/Hayato2846/BetterFriendlist/blob/main/LICENSE).

# Changelog

All notable changes to BetterFriendlist will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

---

## [3.1.9]        - 2026-11-24

Add a third sort criterion, customize friend colors, or move Settings independently of the friends list. This update also reduces background work while the friends list is closed.

### All WoW Versions

#### Added
- **Tertiary Sort** - Use Enable Tertiary Sort under Groups & Filters to add a third criterion to the friends list and detailed broker tooltip. The third slot offers the unused options from Secondary Sort, so you can sort by Ruleset, then Faction, then Nickname in WoW Forever.
- **Settings Window** - Use the anchor button in the title bar to detach Settings from the friends list. Drag the title bar to move the window, and its position is saved between sessions. Press Escape to close the detached window.
- **Friend Formatting** - Set or reset individual field colors when Name Formatting or Friend Info Formatting uses Custom. Parentheses and brackets around a single field take on its custom color.
- **Friend Status** - Use `%statusonline%` in a custom info line to show AFK and DND only. The existing `%status%` field also shows Online for available friends.
- **Friend Local Time** - Turn on Show Friend Local Time in Display Options to set a friend's time difference from their right-click menu and see their local time in the tooltip. The option starts off and keeps saved time differences when disabled.

#### Improved
- **Name and Info Formatting** - Each custom format field appears when you select its own Custom preset. Switching presets keeps your saved format.
- **Group Management** - The third sort criterion, In-Game group mode, and Recently Added duration settings appear under their respective options when enabled. Their saved values are kept when you turn an option off.
- **Recently Added** - When the friends list is closed, incoming friend changes are processed together. Changes received in combat can catch up when combat ends.
- **Settings Title Bar** - Blizzard and EllesmereUI use compact title-bar icons for the anchor and preview controls. EllesmereUI gives both controls the same size, and hovering brightens the icon.
- **Beta Features** - Experimental settings pages appear in the sidebar and search when Beta Features is enabled.

#### Fixed
- **Friends List** - Closing the window during a refresh stops work on the unfinished list. The next open refreshes the list again.
- **Group Note Sync** - Pending group and note changes sync when the friends list is open and you're out of combat. Updates for an individual Battle.net friend check that friend's note directly.
- **Drag and Drop** - Drag friends between groups with single-click whispering enabled. The drag preview uses the name shown in the friends list and matches the current theme.
- **Raid Tab** - Group changes and combat transitions no longer update the raid controls while the Raid tab or friends window is closed. Auto Raid Assist continues to work in the background.
- **Guild News** - News updates wait until the Guild News panel is visible.
- **Who** - The search countdown updates only while its buttons are visible and picks up at the correct time when reopened.
- **Friends Broker** - The label and tooltip show the same count when a QuickFilter or tag filter is active.
- **Dynamic Tag Groups** - Collapse All Groups and Expand All Groups now apply to tag groups and are available from their right-click menus.
- **Guild Broker** - Online guild members' levels use difficulty colors relative to your character's level.
- **Forever Friend Locations** - When the friends list or broker gets a Forever friend's zone from their Battle.net status, it no longer mistakes text after a dash for the friend's realm.
- **Settings Window** - Controls stay aligned when reading New badges, changing checkboxes, or resizing the window.
- **Friend Tags** - Tag icons keep their editor colors in older right-click menus. The tag hint also accounts for the active dynamic tag group filter.
- **Friend Tag Editor** - Fixed a Lua error when opening certain older tags with custom icons.
- **Custom Theme** - Friend Tag Editor action icons and the welcome message use the configured theme colors.
- **Nickname Hint** - The extra nickname hint stays hidden when the friend's name already shows their nickname.

### WoW Retail & WoW Forever

#### Fixed
- **Social Window** - Opening BetterFriendlist from Blizzard's Social controls respects your window preference and works during combat.
- **Friends Search** - EllesmereUI's Blizzard window skin no longer covers the BetterFriendlist search field with a second background or border.
- **Recent Allies** - Closing the friends window stops a pending search from rebuilding the hidden list.
- **Modern Group Headers** - Korean, Chinese, and Cyrillic group names use fonts that support their characters.
- **Battle.net Friend Tooltips** - Under Other Game Accounts, the Blizzard marker reflects whether a character is on a different realm or belongs to the other faction.
- **Quick Filters** - Removed In Queue and Available for Queue because WoW can block these filters. Existing selections switch back to All Friends.
- **Quick Join** - Group listing changes refresh when you reopen the friends list, reducing background work while it is closed.

### WoW Forever

#### Fixed
- **Escape** - Escape closes BetterFriendlist alongside Blizzard windows when Respect UI Hierarchy is enabled. In combat, Escape also closes the friends list when WoW allows the window to be hidden.
- **Gray Out Other Rulesets** - The setting also dims Retail friends and applies the same gray color to nicknames in custom names and the broker.
- **Title Friend Notes** - BetterFriendlist does less work in the background while your friends list is closed or you're in combat.

---

## [3.1.8]        - 2026-11-23

### All WoW Versions

#### Added
- **Nickname Sorting** - Sort by nickname first or use it to break ties in the friends list and detailed broker tooltip.
- **Broker Friend Tags** - The detailed tooltip can show a Tags column and the same tag groups as your friends list. Use the filter menu to pick or search for tags. Right-click a friend to manage their tags or a tag group to edit it.
- **Dynamic Tag Groups** - You can limit tag groups to online friends playing your version of WoW or using only the Battle.net app. Your other friends keep their tags and still appear in the friends list.

#### Fixed
- **Nicknames** - Editing a nickname stays with the friend you picked, even if two friends have the same display name. Changes made in CustomNames show up in the friends list and broker tooltip, including for BattleTags with no linked characters.
- **Drag and Drop** - Letting go over a friend row no longer moves the friend you were dragging.
- **Friends List** - Fixed cases where a list update could make you whisper, invite, favorite, or remove the wrong friend.

### WoW Retail & WoW Forever

#### Fixed
- **CustomNames** - The CustomNames option shows up in the right-click menu for Battle.net friends when Menu Bridge is enabled.

### WoW Forever

#### Added
- **Gray Out Other Rulesets** - Dim online friends playing on a different Forever ruleset in the friends list and detailed broker tooltip.
- **Ruleset Sorting** - Sort by Forever ruleset first or use it to break ties in the friends list and detailed broker tooltip.

#### Fixed
- **Title Friend Groups** - Fixed a bug that could leave you stuck with the "link isn't ready" message when trying to put a Title Friend in a group.
- **Title Friend Notes** - You can edit short notes you already had on Title Friends without reloading.

---

## [3.1.7]        - 2026-11-22

### All WoW Versions

## [3.1.7]        - 2026-11-22

### All WoW Versions

#### Improved
- **Ruleset Search** - Find Forever friends by ruleset using names such as RP, Roleplay, RP-PvP, or Roleplay PvP. Searching for PvP also finds friends on RP-PvP.
- **Quick Filters** - WoW Forever Only is now called Forever Only.

#### Fixed
- **Forever Ruleset Display** - Battle.net friends show Normal, PvP, RP, or RP-PvP when their game status identifies the ruleset, including when realm information is unavailable. The ruleset also appears for additional game accounts. Unfamiliar ruleset labels are shown as supplied by Battle.net.

### WoW Forever

#### Added
- **My Ruleset Only** - This quick filter shows online friends playing on your own Forever ruleset.

---

## [3.1.6]        - 2026-11-21

### WoW Retail & WoW Forever

#### Fixed
- **Battle.net Party Invites** - The invite button works when WoW provides realm information without a numeric realm ID.

---

## [3.1.5]        - 2026-11-21

### All WoW Versions

#### Fixed
- **Remove Friend** - Character friends can be removed from the right-click menu using Blizzard's confirmation dialog.
- **Friend Notes** - Editing a character friend's note no longer shows an erroneous player-not-found message.
- **Friends List** - Newly added character friends and accepted friend requests appear sooner once the game delivers their details.

### WoW Retail & WoW Forever

#### Fixed
- **Modern Raid Tab** - Online raid and party members have class-colored row backgrounds again.

---

## [3.1.4]        - 2026-11-17

### All WoW Versions

#### Improved
- **Blizzard Friendlist Access** - Moved the option to Advanced under Diagnostics and disabled it once for the 3.1.4 update. Re-enabling requires confirmation that this is for diagnostics only; BetterFriendlist fully replaces Blizzard's friends list and does not support running both lists in parallel.

### WoW Retail & WoW Forever

#### Fixed
- **Who Searches** - A /who command rejected during the search cooldown no longer overwrites the text in the Who search box.

### WoW Forever

#### Improved
- **Who Searches** - Blizzard's wait messages appear in the Who tab in your game client's language. Searches with no result or recognized wait message still show the timeout notice.

### WoW Classic

#### Fixed
- **Who Sorting** - The Name, Level, and Class sort order is kept when Who results refresh or the Who tab is reopened.

---

## [3.1.3]        - 2026-11-15

### All WoW Versions

#### Fixed
- **Settings Menu** - The Settings entry in the contacts menu keeps its normal size when marked New.

---

## [3.1.2]        - 2026-11-14

### All WoW Versions

#### Added
- **Favorite Icon** - Choose the Modern Blizzard favorite star where available, alongside the existing BFL and Blizzard styles.
- **Settings Window** - Everyone now uses the redesigned Settings. Resize the window and keep your preferred size; narrow windows use a separate preview and help window that docks on the free side and remembers its width, height and collapsed state. Open or close it from the Settings edge, use setting tooltips while it is closed, or widen Settings to bring the panel back inside.
- **New Settings** - New options and their categories carry the same New badge as unread changelog entries. Click an individual setting to mark it read; category badges clear when all their new options have been read. Read status is saved per profile.
- **Settings Scrolling** - Enable smooth mouse-wheel scrolling in Settings independently of the friends list. Disabled by default.
- **Window Fonts** - Set fonts and sizes for window titles and main action buttons separately, with previews and a reset to their original fonts.
- **Input Dialogs** - Create groups, tags, and sections, rename groups, or copy links and names in windows that match your BFL theme. You can choose native input dialogs under Theme.
- **BFL Avatar** - Dark, Custom, ElvUI and EllesmereUI hide the avatar by default. Turn off Hide BFL Avatar under Theme to show it again.

#### Improved
- **Side Windows** - Dialogs and hints use the free space beside the friends list and switch sides when needed. In the Modern layout, they prefer the selected tab side.
- **Scrollbars** - Modern scrollbars retain their Blizzard appearance and use the accent color of Dark, Custom, ElvUI or EllesmereUI themes. Disabled scroll arrows stay gray.
- **Friend Tag Editor** - A redesigned editor matches Settings, with tag search, clearer sections, drag-and-drop feedback and direct list actions. Edit icons or custom paths, text, colors and visibility with live previews and pinnable help; per-tag drafts are kept until you apply or discard them, including when switching tags or resizing.
- **Name Formatting** - Browse format fields in a list under Setting details, collapsed by default. Click a field to select its token for copying.
- **QuickFilters & Sorters** - Manage filters and sorters in a simpler list, with descriptions for built-in filters and clearer game and status icons. Matching Blizzard icons are used where available; the remaining icons will be updated in a future release.
- **Groups** - Create a group from a group header, Group Management, or Group Order.
